title: Understanding Non-Response Bias
text: Non-response bias occurs when the individuals who do not respond to a survey differ in meaningful ways from those who do respond. Think about how increasing the sample size and sending reminders might affect the likelihood of getting responses from a more representative group.

title: Impact of Sample Size
text: Increasing the sample size from $$100$$ to $$200$$ means you are reaching out to more students. Consider how this might affect the diversity of responses and the overall reliability of the survey results.

title: Effect of Reminder Emails
text: Sending a reminder email to those who did not respond initially can increase the response rate. Think about how this might change the composition of the respondents and the potential for reducing bias.

title: Comparing Non-Response Bias
